title: psephellus dealbatus
intro: Psephellus dealbatus, commonly known as the White Dandelion or Pyrethrum, is a perennial plant species in the Asteraceae family. The plant is known for its medicinal properties and is used to treat various health issues. It is valued for its health benefits, including its antimicrobial and anti-inflammatory properties, which can help to soothe and calm irritated skin and reduce pain. The bioactive constituents of Psephellus dealbatus include sesquiterpene lactones, which have been shown to exhibit therapeutic actions such as anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antitumor activities.
